notes.title: King of Silence is about to release !!
notes.notes:
King of Silence is finally coming out.
The game had been shelved for some time, as a prototype version intended for publishers.
With the studio about to close, we've decided to release it in more or less the same state as before. For context, the project was developed 2 years ago over a 2-month period by a core team of 5, with the help of an additional 3 people.

We hope you enjoy this short 20-30min project.

The former Onze 8 Degrés team.
